name: Wail of the Sorrowful Dead (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Undead creature

Benefit(s): Once per day you can make a mournful song so that all that hear it within 10 feet per your Hit Dice suffer a morale penalty on all attack rolls, saving throws, skill checks, and ability checks equal to half your Hit Dice, unless they make a successful Will save (DC 15 + 1/2 your Hit Dice + your Charisma modifier). This is a sonic-based mind-affecting fear effect.
